text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stands at the Yasuda Kinen are absolutely packed—mostly with Oguri Cap fans, it seems. The enthusiasm around her has grown so massive that you could call her a cultural icon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even in the paddock, Oguri Cap's popularity feels oppressive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, Yaeno Muteki is determined to win the crowd over. Her race against Oguri Cap is about to begin!
